preflight.block_reason: The GitHub connector returned a truncated historical data/pending_workers/jobs tree. A direct shallow git clone was attempted from the execution environment but failed because github.com DNS resolution was unavailable. Therefore body-by-body verification of every historical pending worker file cannot be truthfully confirmed. Per worker rules, no candidate is staged as QUALIFIED while this mandatory preflight is incomplete.

discovery.target_raw: 140-150 distinct low-overlap employer-level raw candidates if sources genuinely allow
discovery.notes: Only employer names actually surfaced in fresh search results were counted. The web search backend merged multiple regional queries into one result stream and did not preserve reliable per-query attribution, so per-batch raw and duplicate+early-reject rates are left null instead of being reconstructed or invented.
